rows.context_and_review_note: Exact-base DimensionControls.kt:54-57 requires finite positive inputs; pixel mode requires integral inputs, while percent mode converts against the original dimension. rows.backtranslation: In each image, the amount to remove from each edge must not exceed the image dimension (width or height). Use whole pixel counts or percent.
rows.context_and_review_note: Exact-base ImageAssembly.kt:43-48 converts percent against corresponding width/height, requires p<=base, and requires integral counts only in pixel mode. Revised image dimension with explicit width/height parenthesis to exclude byte size. Whole modifies pixel counts, not percentages; fractional percent remains allowed. Each image is independently constrained. The separate :49 check still rejects combined opposing margins that leave zero or negative size; this translation does not claim equality of a single margin guarantees a valid final crop.
